purpose: Offline deterministic policy evaluation; not simulated traffic, production inventory, or an uplift estimate.

definitions.repeatedCreatorInventory: 30 items from one creator and 8 from another, all published within the 30-day window.
definitions.sparseSingleCreatorInventory: Seven recent authored items from one creator; demonstrates soft-cap relaxation.
definitions.smallRelevanceGroups: Nine relevance groups sized one through nine, all authored items recent.
definitions.newItemVsEditorialAndCatalogControl: 18 old authored items, 4 new authored items, and curated wedding/birthday entries in one relevance group.
definitions.overlookedRecentPromotion: 18 old authored items sort ahead of four recent authored items; cumulative global milestones may promote a recent item over older items without demoting any recent item from its ordinary position.
definitions.equalRelevanceBarriers: Direct [0], related [1], and less relevant [2] vectors with editorial keys across groups.
definitions.creatorRunResetsAtRelevanceGroup: The same creator spans adjacent relevance groups to test cap scope.
definitions.utcDayTieStability: 60 eligible recent authored items; order remains stable across adjacent UTC days without rotating or holding recent items.

previousBaselineV1Finding.provenance: Historical offline result recorded in slice 05 before this version; it is carried forward as a prior fixture finding and is not recomputed by the current policy.
